cohort: 100 mothers of preterm infants born before 32 weeks of gestation and their infants followed up over 18 months at 3 French university hospitals.
finding: 60.4% of mothers of preterm infants experienced postpartum posttraumatic reactions within 18 months of delivery, with shorter gestational age at delivery, C-section, and the mother's psychological state at each assessment time being significantly associated with these symptoms.
mod_finding: C-section was statistically linked to posttraumatic symptoms in mothers of preterm infants.
